limitation: A rank position among pre-treatment reference blocks. A 5% claim is arithmetically unavailable at this resolution.

value: nonzero on 2026-06-28 and 2026-07-05, then zero through the available endpoint 2026-07-15
limitation: Aggregate index. It cannot identify vessels or destinations and must stay separate from the PortWatch all-tanker series.

statement: Modeled resolved terminal-sequence support, overall and Hormuz-crossing, at 30 km.
limitation: A missing modeled edge is a missing observation, never evidence that no ship sailed. No AIS-dark throughput may be inferred.

limitation: A criteria table. It grants no admission and no third layer is admitted.

limitation: Descriptive phase contrasts only. The windows are context scoring, not a treatment date.

limitation: Compositional and support-conditional. The split does not generalise across radius or cohort, and the sign is not universal.

limitation: A forecast shortfall, not a treatment effect. PortWatch counts all tankers and has no LNG class.

statement: Same-model shortfall difference between the pinned July and August PortWatch vintages.
limitation: A case-local measurement-state sensitivity. Not a variance decomposition and vintages are never averaged.
